rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a plant seed or bulk seed, and it is also used metaphorically for the beginning of an idea and technically for a tournament seed or random-generator seed.

example.english: I bought a packet of seed to plant at home.
example.traditional: 我買咗包種子返屋企種。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 baau1 zung2 zi2 faan1 uk1 kei2 zung3

rows.note: Use this specifically when “seed” means semen rather than a plant seed or a metaphorical beginning.

example.english: The doctor said there was blood in his seed.
example.traditional: 醫生話佢嘅精液入面有血。
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 ge3 zing1 jik6 jap6 min6 jau5 hyut3
